Notes: Reply: أهلاً بيك (ahlan bik, to a man) / بيكي (biki, to a woman).
Reply: صباح النور (saba7 en-nur), 'morning of light'.
Same spelling as the masculine; only the vowel differs.
The most common answer to 'how are you?'.
Use to get attention or ask politely. To a woman: law sama7ti.

English: Do you speak English? (to a man)

Notes: Said about anything in the future.
Goes at the end: ismak eh? = your name what?
Point at something and say: da bikam? = How much is this?
Also means 'life', since bread is life.
Haggling: da ghali awi! = That's very expensive!
Goes after the word: kwayyis awi = very good.
